title: Paladin Energy
summary: Australian uranium producer restarting the Langer Heinrich mine.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

Paladin Energy restarted uranium production at Langer Heinrich in Namibia and holds development assets in Canada and Australia. It sells concentrate to utilities under long-term contracts, and its economics depend on realised prices and ramp-up. Namibian operations carry country and water risks.

Technology Exposure

  • Uranium mining and concentrate
  • Restart and expansion projects
  • Utility sales contracts

What To Watch

  • Production ramp
  • Uranium prices
  • Namibian operating conditions

Record Notes

Editorial brief compiled 19 November 2026 from company disclosures, agency publications and press reporting. Figures are as reported by those sources and have not been independently audited; no live market data is used.
